projects.title: Under One Roof
projects.description:
Get that Glow Beauty Weekend

In collaboration with Prishtina Mall, we organized a dedicated weekend exclusively for skin health and beauty on June 24 and 25. Together with 15 brands that have stores at Prishtina Mall, we offered a special experience to the audience.

The event's primary focus was on promoting beauty offers, services, and products.

Visitors had the opportunity to determine their skin type, sample various makeup products, and receive tips and recommendations for their skin health. All of this was complemented by music, delicious food, and drinks – a true party!

Unforgettable…

data.content: In collaboration with Prishtina Mall, we organized a dedicated weekend exclusively for skin health and beauty on June 24 and 25. Together with 15 brands that have stores at Prishtina Mall, we offered a special experience to the audience.
The event's primary focus was on promoting beauty offers, services, and products.
Prishtina Mall is one of the largest shopping centres in Southeast Europe. With great enthusiasm, we collaborated in organising events for the retailers of this centre and providing PR services.

We have written several online articles for well-known portals, promoting the brands that were coming to Prishtina Mall, informing the wider audience about the new experiences that this centre brought for the first time in Kosovo and the region.
We have managed social media pages as well, by bringing highly important and visually appealing information, through designs, animations, and various videos.
